To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present the first mixed signal real-time vital sign monitoring system implemented on a mixed signal reconfigurable platform.

we have developed a real time vital sign monitoring system that consumes 1.8 mW of power and achieves an average percentage error bounded by 4% 8% for R R interval, systolic blood, and oxygen saturation measurements.
we developed a mixed signal physical computation electronics to monitor three vital signs in real time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a low power and low area cardiac processor that performs real time signal acquisition and physiologically relevant signal processing in an analog domain.
the design of a real time vital sign monitoring system that operates on a physical computation platform.
the design of low power, energy efficient, and accurate vital sign monitoring system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work presents a novel and efficient mixed signal physical computation electronics for vital sign monitoring.
a real time vital sign monitoring system is presented that is capable of processing ECG, blood oxygen saturation, and blood pressure signals.
the presented system is a low power, energy efficient, and patient dependent system for monitoring three vital signals in real time.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a real time vital sign monitoring system has been designed and implemented on a FPAA platform. The design is energy efficient and
the proposed system has the ability to monitor three vital signs in the physical domain with an acceptable accuracy and energy consumption.
we have demonstrated the viability of physical computation for vital signs monitoring.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed system can be used for real time vital sign monitoring in the physical domain on a mixed signal reconfigurable platform.

the proposed system is a step forward in realizing the vision of a wearable, battery operated, and energy efficient cardiac processor that performs real time monitoring of vital signs in a mixed signal environment.
the physical computation electronics is able to perform low and high level signal processing tasks in a power efficient manner.
